formula: E perpendicular B perpendicular k; c = lambda nu
scope_label: Classical electromagnetic-field representation; not a photon trajectory.
definition: Propagation arrow k with mutually transverse electric and magnetic field oscillations.

formula: E = h nu = h c / lambda; p = h / lambda; E = p c
scope_label: Single-photon relations in vacuum.
definition: Aligned wavelength and frequency states mapped to energy and momentum.

formula: F = q E; q = -e; a = F / m_e
scope_label: Classical point-particle approximation.
definition: A negative charge in a uniform electric field with force opposite the field direction.

formula: F = q(E + v times B); r = p / (|q| B)
scope_label: Uniform field and perpendicular-motion case for the radius relation.
definition: An electron path bends in a uniform magnetic field with velocity, force, and curvature directions.

scope_label: Electrically neutral flavor states; not classical species paths.
definition: Three linked flavor lanes represent electron, muon, and tau neutrino states.

formula: P(nu_alpha -> nu_beta) = sin^2(2 theta) sin^2(Delta m^2 L / (4 E))
scope_label: Two-flavor vacuum approximation with natural units and alpha not equal to beta.
definition: A baseline L connects source and detector while the flavor composition changes.

scope_label: Electric charges; visual colors are labels, not literal QCD color.
definition: Two structural rows encode repeated up-type and down-type fractional charges.

formula: p = uud; n = udd; Q_p/e = 1; Q_n/e = 0
scope_label: Valence-quark bookkeeping; sea quarks and gluons remain part of the physical description.
definition: Two color-neutral triplets map valence composition to proton and neutron charge.

scope_label: Schematic QCD color flow; displayed colors are representational labels.
definition: A quark line changes its color label while a gluon carries a color-anticolor link.

formula: V(r) approximately kappa r at large r
scope_label: Qualitative long-distance confinement model, not a universal all-distance potential.
definition: A narrowing flux tube links separating color sources as stored field energy increases.

formula: E(r) = e r_hat / (4 pi epsilon_0 r^2)
scope_label: Far-field classical approximation; does not depict proton internal structure.
definition: A radial electric field surrounds a localized positive source.

scope_label: Valence-quark charge bookkeeping.
definition: A triangular uud composition closes to one positive elementary charge.

scope_label: Electrical neutrality does not mean absence of internal charged constituents.
definition: A triangular udd composition closes to zero net charge.

scope_label: Free-neutron beta decay; a neutron bound in a stable nucleus is not treated as freely decaying.
definition: A free neutron transforms into a proton, electron, and electron antineutrino.

scope_label: Massive electroweak gauge bosons; no classical force-particle trajectory claim.
definition: Three linked mediator nodes show W+, W-, and Z0 with distinct charge labels.

formula: d -> u + W^-; W^- -> e^- + anti-nu_e
scope_label: Schematic interaction bookkeeping, not a resolved classical time sequence.
definition: Two linked vertices connect a down quark to an up quark and a W- decay pair.

scope_label: Schematic Higgs-potential convention; parameters and normalization are stated.
definition: A symmetric scalar-field potential marks a vacuum ring and radial excitation direction.

scope_label: Fermion Yukawa mass relation; this does not supply most proton or neutron mass.
definition: A small excitation about the vacuum maps to the fermion mass-coupling relation.

formula: A = Z + N; nuclide = superscript A subscript Z X
scope_label: Z is proton number, N is neutron number, and A is nucleon number.
definition: A proton-neutron cluster maps to standard nuclide notation.

formula: Delta m = Z m_p + N m_n - m_nucleus > 0; E_b = Delta m c^2
scope_label: Binding energy uses the stated positive mass-defect convention.
definition: Separated nucleons converge to a bound nucleus while an energy carrier leaves.
